scope: Read-only frozen source/actual51IO classification and reuse of existing UART software evidence; no hardware commands, test reruns, new synthesis or PNR.

classified_ports.required_signoff: Board50MHz oscillator; check actual clock source/waveform/jitter and primary clock path. set_input_delay is not a clock-port constraint.
PHY-recovered RX clock; RTL MAC describes100M/25MHz operation, while the frozen SDC constrains10ns. Verify actual PHY mode/delay straps/RX edge and explicitly document the chosen timing envelope.

Physical button enters async-assert/sync-release nav_rst_sync. Review deassert synchronization, reset recovery/removal, pulse width, bounce/power-up. Do not fabricate a synchronous core-clock input delay.

Both enter nav_sync2 before bit sampling. Bind real first/second synchronizers, preserve second-stage setup/hold, establish baud/clock-tolerance and min-pulse sampling envelope plus board IO levels. No arbitrary zero delay or broad clock-domain exception.

IR has two-stage synchronization; encoders have three sample stages. Audit exact physical chains, metastability-resolution paths, maximum pulse/AB phase/noise bounds and reset behavior. Input timing is asynchronous, not a source-synchronous setup/hold assertion to clk50.

RXD/CTL are sampled at both RXC edges and selected after neg_s synchronization. Need actual RTL8211F output-delay min/max plus PCB skew, RX delay strap/register mode and both-edge capture constraints; preserve the26 internal CDC paths as a separate issue.

At50MHz HP=1, data updates from posedge logic and forwarded TXC changes on negedge clk. Sign off generated25MHz TXC waveform, TXD/CTL min/max at PHY, board skew and PHY setup/hold on applicable edges. Use measured/datasheet budgets, not zero.

CH9102 nav bridge921600 8N1 and P11/A16 V2 transmitter nominal230400 8N1. Verify divider-derived bit periods, pin tCO/jitter and electrical link/decoder tolerance. There is no external synchronous capture clock that justifies an invented clk50-relative output delay.

Names sck/sda are OLED I2C, not SPI. Master drives only0/Z and synchronizes observed levels. Check pull-ups/voltage/rise-fall/bus capacitance, SCL-high/low and START/STOP/data setup/hold with external device timing; audit input synchronizers and clock-stretch timeout.

Same shared iic engine, QUARTER_CYCLES125 at50MHz gives nominal100kHz. Verify both devices ACK/config readback/atomic6-axis samples, bus electrical limits and serial timing/clock stretch; no SPI CS/MOSI/MISO interface exists in these51 pads.

MDC is a divided core-clock output; MDIO is bidirectional with turnaround and direct scheduled sampling. Verify PHY tDO/setup/hold to actual MDC edges, board delay/OE turnaround and pull-up. Do not blanket-false-path MDIO as an unconstrained unrelated input.
RTL holds PHY reset20ms then waits100ms. Verify target PHY reset/power timing and output release; not a payload synchronous output-delay contract.

This routed baseline has no enabled NAV_USE_SFP hardware macro; host MAC is a same-clk stub, sfp1_los is unused and tx_dis is constant0. It is not the accepted real Lane2 SFP implementation. Document unused input/output electrical policy before using this image as a UART-host delivery.

These are PWM/direction/pulse-width signals rather than an external clocked data bus. Sign off internal clock closure, actual pin pulse min/max, direction/PWM transition contract, glitches/startup/reset/fault behavior, motor-driver/servo voltage and physical stop response. Servo20ms frames and default500..2500us bounds need actual-board verification; arbitrary0 output delays would not prove them.
Document low-speed observation/electrical intent and absence of an external synchronous capture contract. Missing input/output delay on LEDs alone is not a failed functional timing path.

current_stop_chain.top: NAV SAFE ch_stop/ch_wdog -> command_units kill -> command_lease -> zero/ramped nav_forward/yaw -> control4500_core
current_stop_chain.reason: Current firmware has no host RX age gate; autonomous planner can continue publishing new SAFE commands. The raw-command watchdog and periodic SAFE lease do not measure RK link liveness.

remaining_integration_gaps: Treat routed32/35 as diagnostic until real core50MHz/global setup/hold/reset/pulse and interface-specific IO gates pass;35 CDC52 only covers26 async first stages, not pad IO timing.

Bind source-synchronous PHY RX/TX/MDIO timing to actual PHY configuration, min/max external timing and board skew. Resolve/document25MHz MAC mode versus10ns constraint envelope; do not fill arbitrary0 input/output delays.

Inventory physical UART/IR/encoder/I2C synchronizer endpoints and first-to-second resolution paths; separately approve only justified asynchronous-pad exceptions. The26 radar CDC inventory does not cover these pad inputs.

Integrate the existing host_link_guard and companion RK heartbeat/new-idle/0.5s feedback handshake into the selected image/production service. All61 original FW sources match this baseline, so the existing finite proof origin is reusable, but candidate BIN/128KiB INIT and actual joint implementation must be rebound; no guard is present in current32/35.

Close main-loop/long MMIO/capture/matcher waits and command-publication latency into an actual full-software timeout bound. Candidate1s is a proposed parameter, not a measured full-CPU/vehicle stop bound.

Verify real CH9102 SYS_ID/R0 mailbox request/reply/ACK overlap and full V2 sensor/sequence/CRC/device freshness on the selected SRAM image; preserve unique serial ownership. Last passive V2 transport proof had sensor_error1/inference0 and NAV ID got0 replies, so it cannot authorize motion.

Before motion, define and test explicit idle/zero/lease arming, host loss, telemetry loss, reconnect no-replay, new mission unlock and physical stop feedback. R0 K/NV ACK/zero target must not be substituted for actual standstill.
Record actual electrical/pull-up/drive/pin roles and intended SFP stub/disable behavior for this legacy UART-host baseline; the real Lane2 SFP acceptance is a different frozen implementation.
